scope: MEI occupations of Anexo XI with ISS = S, one entry per CNAE subclass
notes: Curated by Stackin, not official: no public body publishes a CNAE to cTribNac correlation. Each CNAE subclass lists the national service codes (cTribNac, LC 116 subitem plus national desdobro) whose description covers the service of the occupations that use it. An empty list means no code describes it clearly. needs_review marks the entries whose links, or lack of links, rest on a reading of the LC 116 text rather than on an explicit mention. Each source's sha256 is the hash of the file at its path. Not reviewed by an accountant yet.
